title: Base change of a finitely presented module
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and let $M$ be a finitely presented $A$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Then $B\otimes_AM$, a $B$-module through the first factor, is a finitely presented $B$-module.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 10.12.15 (Tag 05G5), finitely presented modules and base change
